title: Replacement Terms: Quantity and Carriage of a Courtesy Reship of Test Strips
content:
**Quantity.** On the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program a courtesy reship carries the customer for a bounded number of days rather than repeating the whole package, and it never ships more units than the refill it stands in for. The standard courtesy reship covers one 30-day block, and it ships the strips for those days plus the transit days at the tier's strip allowance per rolling 90 days for a customer not treated with insulin divided by 90 strips a day, divided by the strips per billing unit and rounded up to a whole unit, never more than the refill's units. The refill it stands in for is the program's latest strip refill. A courtesy reship quantified this way ships the units stated here, which stay within the cap the replacement terms set.

**Carriage.** The courtesy reship ships expedited at no charge when the refill it stands in for shipped expedited at no charge, because Larkfield then owed that refill a two-day delivery, and by standard shipping otherwise, a customer-paid expedite included. Its transit days are 7 when it ships by standard shipping and 2 when it ships expedited.

| How the refill stood in for shipped | How the courtesy reship ships | Transit days |
|---|---|---|
| expedited at no charge | expedited at no charge | 2 |
| standard | standard | 7 |
| expedited, paid by the customer | standard | 7 |

**Combination.** Any rule that changes this reship changes only the quantity it names: the days the reship covers are replaced first, then days are added to them, before the strips a day are applied; the strips are then multiplied before strips are added; and the rounding and the cap above apply last.

**Worked example (hypothetical; an illustrative allowance of 240 strips per 90 days).** The refill stood in for held 6 units and shipped by standard shipping.

1. Days carried: one 30-day block plus 7 transit days, that is 37 days.
2. Strips a day: 240 divided by 90, that is 2.67.
3. Strips: 37 times 2.67, that is 98.67.
4. Units: 98.67 divided by 50 is 1.97, rounded up to 2 units, within the refill's 6.

Had the refill been expedited at no charge, 32 days would give 85.33 strips, also 2 units, sent expedited at no charge. With an illustrative allowance of 600 strips, 37 days give 246.67 strips, that is 5 units; a refill of only 3 units would cap the reship at 3.
